credits.title: Agnes & Amir
credits.overview: Amir is 28, gay and has just fled from Iran. Agnes is 101 and still too young for a retirement home - she thinks. The two move in together - and save each other's lives.

credits.title: Lord
credits.overview: On the edge of Hamburg, worlds collide. When Lord (17) saves Betty (78) from suicide, an unexpected door opens for both. Between suspicion and closeness, a quiet alliance is formed: against invisibility, poverty and resignation.

credits.title: All Russians Love Birch Trees
credits.overview: After her boyfriend becomes extremely ill, Mascha re-evaluates her path and decides to leave her previous life behind. But it's only by returning home that she can find peace.

credits.title: Darkroom
credits.overview: Lars, a male nurse from Saarbrücken, moves to Berlin with his lover, Roland. They begin to renovate an apartment and their happiness seems almost complete. What Roland doesn’t know is that, while secretly checking out Berlin’s night life, Lars is also experimenting with a deadly poison.

credits.title: Der Schrei
credits.overview: Niko drifts aimlessly through everyday life without paying attention to social rules.

credits.title: Love Note
credits.overview: A girl spends her life exclusively in her digitized apartment, her sole contact with the outside world is by online chat. That is, until a power cut forces her to switch to traditional forms of communication.

credits.title: Jesus Cries
credits.overview: JESUS CRIES is a modern adaptation of the New Testament. The story is set in a fictitious metropolis in the near future. The First and Third Worlds are reflected in one city.
